description: End-to-end flows (Playwright), axe-core accessibility scans and Lighthouse scores of a LOCAL Fundproof server, written by scripts/web_metrics.py. One entry per target; each says what was measured (target.label) and has its own provenance block. A target that is not listed here was not measured. The Hugging Face Space is not measured by this script.

target.label: LOCAL Docker container on the machine that ran this script, started WITH the dev login (UWC_DEV_AUTH=1) so the script can sign in without Hugging Face OAuth. NOT the Hugging Face Space, which refuses the dev login: no internet hop, no Space proxy, not Space hardware.

auth.note: The browser signed in through the DEV LOGIN form (POST /api/auth/dev-login), which exists only when the server runs with UWC_DEV_AUTH=1 and is refused inside a Hugging Face Space. Hugging Face sign-in was not exercised.

server.disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.

caveats: A local run: the server and the browser share one machine (4 CPUs here, shared with other jobs; see provenance.environment). Timings and Lighthouse performance scores say nothing about the Space.
Sign-in used the DEV LOGIN (UWC_DEV_AUTH=1); Hugging Face OAuth was not exercised.
Lighthouse scores are listed per run with their median; no confidence interval is given because a few runs on one machine are not independent samples of anything wider.
axe-core finds only the problems that can be detected automatically; zero violations is not a statement of WCAG conformance. Its 'incomplete' items need a person to review them.
The founder plan, the lender decision and the edited targets are SYNTHETIC test inputs, not data.
